title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette and a threshold read-out to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The picture view uses an orange-on-black flame and a red tip line; some colour-blind users cannot tell the red line from the flame.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tip line, burner line and flame distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real-footage example to Session 3 (with a ruler and permission to share)
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses only a synthetic video, so students never see the pipeline on a real clip.

## Context
The mini-project describes how to film a candle. A short, safely recorded clip with a ruler would show real glare and auto-exposure.

## Expected outcome
A short clip (at most 5 MB) you are allowed to share, a notebook that runs `frames_from_pngs` and `measure_video` on it, and a paragraph on how the result differs from the synthetic one.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `docs/`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The clip is yours to share and shows no people
- [ ] The notebook runs in Colab
- [ ] Differences from the synthetic case are explained

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: glare correction before thresholding
body:
## Problem
The first roadmap milestone does not exist yet: a halo around the flame lifts the background and biases the measured height.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4, and the Atlas chapter on veiling glare.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a two-frame-rate aliasing resolver
body:
## Problem
One aliased clip cannot reveal the true frequency, but two clips at different frame rates can.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2 (a 17 Hz flicker seen as 13 Hz at 30 fps and 7 Hz at 24 fps).

## Expected outcome
A function `resolve_alias(f1, fs1, f2, fs2, f_max)` with tests, including a refusal case where two true frequencies remain possible.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 17 Hz recovered within 0.2 Hz
- [ ] Ambiguous inputs return an explicit refusal

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: measurement view with glare correction
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a measurement view of a flame video; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Height error below 0.5 px on a clip with a glare halo
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
